requirements.text: Introduce a Decision compiler and decision_build for routine intent-to-knowledge work with explicit user semantic approval and gateway-validated KB updates.
Route accepted decisions by product-first or system-first abstraction and propagate impact to the opposite layer with explicit direction and no-impact evidence.
Make core system diagrams the system navigation spine and ontology.
Require diagram_refs for system docs, with rich diagram node types and requires_doc for mandatory detail docs.
Simplify default graph around Decision, Knowledge, Work, Execution, and Proof while retaining exact trace/audit lenses.
Limit parallelism to read-only preflight/draft lanes and keep canonical promotion serial.
Use risk-tiered gates so users approve semantic decisions/escalations and gateways validate lower-layer artifacts.
Run the self-refactor through current CodeWiki in compatibility/freeze mode with vNext behind compatibility until validated.
Reduce vNext public/agent tool surface to fewer workflow tools and move low-level primitives internal or compatibility-only.
